content:
A Moment of Recognition & Gratitude

I am honoured to receive this award for my contribution and dedicated work as a member of the Moot Court Society.

Being an active member of the society has been a great learning experience, allowing me to strengthen my skills in legal research, teamwork, coordination, communication, and advocacy.

This recognition motivates me to continue contributing to the society, learning from every opportunity, and growing as a law student.

I am grateful to my faculty, mentors, seniors, and fellow members for their constant guidance, support, and encouragement.

Proud to be a part of the Moot Court Society and excited to contribute further. ⚖️🏆
